If you've worked with other agencies before and felt like just another number, that's the experience we built E4 to change.

job.title: Registered Nurse - Australia Contracts
job.description:
Medical & Surgical Nurses – Regional Australia Contracts 

We’re seeking experienced Medical/Surgical Registered Nurses from New Zealand to join short-term regional contracts across New South Wales, Australia.

What’s on offer:

✅ 6–12 week contracts
✅ Travel covered for contracts over 6 weeks
✅ Fully supplied accommodation
✅ Competitive rates: $51.97 – $68.97/hr + superannuation + penalties
✅ The opportunity to experience regional Australia while making a real impact
✅ Contracts available within Regional Base Hospitals and Multipurpose Services.

Available locations: 

📍 Grafton (Northern NSW)
A beautiful Clarence Valley location known for its relaxed lifestyle, riverside setting and easy access to stunning beaches and national parks. 

📍 Lismore (Northern NSW)
A vibrant regional hub in the Northern Rivers, offering a mix of culture, nature, cafes, markets and the great outdoors. 

📍 Hunter New England locations
Work across diverse regional communities within one of NSW’s largest health regions. Enjoy everything from country towns and scenic landscapes, while gaining valuable experience across varied clinical settings.

📍 Broken Hill
Experience the iconic Australian outback with a rich history, incredible sunsets and a truly unique lifestyle. Broken Hill offers nurses the opportunity to make a real difference while experiencing something completely different.

📍 Western NSW locations
Discover wide-open spaces, regional hospitality and a slower pace of life in the geographically largest NSW Health District (an area similar in size to Britain).

We’re looking for nurses with:

✔️ 2+ years’ medical or surgical nursing experience
✔️ Strong acute nursing skills
✔️ Cannulation & venepuncture experience
✔️ Team Leader experience desirable
✔️ Working rights in Australia (NZ Citizenship)

Whether you’re looking for a change of scenery, the chance to develop your skills or a rewarding short-term contract - we’d love to hear from you.

Get in touch with Katie today for a non-committal chat or to discuss any questions you may have!

katiej@e4people.com.au | 0483 904 386
